body: Friday: I mended three work shirts from the seed trial. White powder shook from every cuff; my hands blistered before anyone closed the road.
title: Hemmed cuffs from the trial field
gloss: A personal trace places field-program residue before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have encountered the same residue while responding; the personal trace does not by itself prove the field program caused the emergency.

body:
The woman brought in a coat with its pocket torn. While I pinned it, a folded list fell out. She asked me to sew the pocket closed with the list inside.

She said her brother would need the coat if he returned. I offered to write his name on the label. She shook her head so hard she dropped the thread.

I used a different color along the seam. If he comes back, someone can find the paper without ruining the whole coat.
title: A sleeve sewn shut
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
